name: email-scheduler
description: Production-grade Email Scheduler & Dispatcher with BullMQ, Redis, Ethereal, Elasticsearch, and Slack alerts

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && npx prisma db push && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start:redis: powershell -Command "if (-not (Test-Path bin/redis/data)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force bin/redis/data }; Start-Process -FilePath bin/redis/redis-server.exe -WorkingDirectory bin/redis/data -ArgumentList '--save 60 1' -WindowStyle Hidden -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
